data.one_liner: VSCode-style syntax highlighting and code editing widgets for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The package uses TextMate rules to provide syntax highlighting for multiple programming languages, returning a formatted TextSpan. It also includes a simplistic CodeEditor widget supporting rich text copying.
use_when: You need to display syntax-highlighted code blocks in your Flutter application.
You require a basic code editor widget with rich text copy capabilities.
avoid_when: You need advanced code editing features like line numbers, complex autocompletion, or deep IDE integrations.
strengths: Supports many popular programming languages out of the box using TextMate grammar rules.
Easy to extend with new grammar files.
weaknesses: Requires manual asynchronous initialization of languages and themes before use.
data.setup_notes: Requires initializing the highlighter and loading themes and grammar files asynchronously before use.
